'''Lumba trees''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Tree/Legends|tree]]. A terrace garden in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] contained lumba trees. They began to wilt in the [[Autumn/Legends|fall]] season.
